name: Sniper Rifle
description: A bolt-action sniper rifle: one heavy, dead-straight round a pull that drops a Blockhead in one hit, a blue ring trail, muzzle smoke and a bolt to work between shots. Right-click (or the zoom key) to look through its scope; the mouse wheel zooms further, and crouching steadies the aim. Our own take on Kaje's Sniper Rifle and Conan's Sniper Rifle Updated.
authors: design by Kaje (Sniper Rifle) and Conan (Sniper Rifle Updated)
